description: Audience-dependent readability: Students grade 8, Faculty/Staff grade 10 (Flesch-Kincaid).

rules.name: Reading level above audience target
rules.message: The overall reading level is higher than recommended for this audience.
rules.suggestion: Use shorter sentences and simpler words

rules.name: Hard-to-read sentence
rules.message: This sentence is much harder to read than the audience target.
rules.suggestion: Use simpler words or split the sentence

rules.name: Long sentence
rules.message: Long sentences are harder to follow. UIC voice favors short, punchy sentences.
rules.source: UIC Voice and tone (short, punchy sentences); limits (students 20, faculty/staff 25 words) are team-defined
rules.suggestion: Split into two or more sentences

rules.name: Long paragraph
rules.message: Long paragraphs are hard to scan.
rules.suggestion: Break into shorter paragraphs or a bulleted list

rules.name: Complex word with a plain alternative
rules.message: A simpler word is easier to read.
rules.source: UIC Voice and tone ("no fluff"); word list is team-defined
